title: Vine Boom
blurb: The Vine Boom — the deep bass hit that turns any pause into a punchline. It began life as a stock cinematic impact, the kind trailer editors use for dramatic reveals, before Vine's six-second format turned it into comedy punctuation. When you only have moments to land a joke, one enormous boom does the work a laugh track needs ten seconds for. Vine died; its grammar didn't. Today it's the internet's default way to underline a moment — someone says something unhinged, the camera zooms, boom. Arguably the most-used editing sound of the decade, and still not tired.
origin: Originated as a bass drop sound on Vine; became the universal meme emphasis hit.
